title: J. C. Smissaert (Raad der Aziatische Bezittingen) to C. J. Prediger at Batavia, 20 Nov 1800 (Nationaal Archief 2.01.27.02 inv. 209): key of the letter cipher rebuilt from the clear minute and validated

documents.shelfmark: The Hague, Nationaal Archief, 2.01.27.02 (Raad der Aziatische Bezittingen en Etablissementen), inv. 209, scan 0002 (right-hand page); clear minute on scans 0001, 0002 (left) and 0004
documents.route: J. C. Smissaert, secretary of the Raad der Aziatische Bezittingen -> C. J. Prediger, Batavia

plaintext.source: The clear minute of the same letter, in the same file (scans 0001, 0002 left, 0004): the passages to encipher are underlined, with strokes counting their letters.

transcription.source: Nationaal Archief scans of inv. 209 (downloadable; no licence stated on the record)
transcription.notes: Digit columns read top/bottom and noted before the clear was read (frozen/RAW-hauts-bas.txt); two copying slips in the learning part corrected from those notes (frozen/AMENDEMENT-01.md). One AI transcriber.

system.summary: Simple substitution of letters for Dutch: each letter is a column of two digits, a top digit 1-7 over a bottom digit 1-4 (a 7 x 4 grid, 28 cells; i/j share one). Only the sensitive words are enciphered; word division kept.

prior_solution.where: The clear minute of the same letter is filed with it (scans 0001, 0002 left, 0004), with the passages to encipher underlined; the archive's description names the encipherment ('overbrenging in cijfer'). So the content is existing. No key, edition or study found: nothing in this repository (catalogue.json and research/leads.json on main 1e974a24, targets, issue and PR search for Batavia, Smissaert, Prediger, 2.01.27.02, Aziatische; GitHub API, 9 Nov 2026); two web searches without result.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the rules (protocol hashed before the clear was read, one held-out measurement, thresholds fixed in advance). AI agents found the file in a sweep of the Nationaal Archief, transcribed, aligned, built the key, measured and read. No human palaeographer checked the transcription.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Cipher of scan 0002 transcribed as top/bottom digit columns and hashed before the clear minute was read.

Lines L01-L12 aligned word by word with the clear minute (frozen/A-ALIGN.tsv); key = majority letter per code, built by script, 23 codes, no conflict; frozen before the clear of the held-out lines was opened.

One measurement on lines L13-L14 (60 letters): 0.933 of characters against at best 0.433 for 200 shuffled keys (margin 0.500), coverage 0.983; thresholds 0.85 and 0.30 fixed in advance. Declared: the beginning of the held-out clear was glimpsed on the learning crop (frozen/AMENDEMENT-01.md).
Whole cipher read with the key and checked against the minute: 60 cipher words, 54 certain, 3 probable, 3 restored, 0 unresolved.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The key was learned from the clear minute of the same letter, filed with it, and validated once on a held-out passage. The content is the minute's (existing); the key and the identification of the pair are the contribution.

validation.notes: Contributor's pre-registered held-out test (not docs/_validate.py): 0.933 of characters vs best of 200 shuffled keys 0.433 (margin 0.500), coverage 0.983. Not blind on the held-out words (their clear was glimpsed before the freeze, declared); the key is built by script from the learning part only. 54 = f added after the measurement.

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.md: 60 cipher words, 54 certain + 3 probable = 57 read by sense; 3 restored (checked against the minute) excluded.

credits.note: the clear minute of the letter, filed with it (scans 0001, 0002 left, 0004), with the passages to encipher underlined; the key was learned from it
cipher of scan 0002 transcribed; letter key rebuilt from the minute and validated on a held-out passage (key.tsv, validation.txt); pair identified

gaps.item: the rest of the clear minute and the postscript (scans 0004-0005) not transcribed
one reader (an agent) on the digit columns; no human palaeographic check
q unseen; 54 = f from one word only

texts.label: Smissaert to Prediger, 20 Nov 1800, the letter as sent (scan 0002)
texts.summary: Besides the long-delayed troop shipment to the Indies, the Asiatic Council has been authorised to prepare a second, similar expedition to Batavia from another place in Europe, which would considerably reinforce the military on Java; Prediger is to tell the Governor-General in secrecy.

reading_review.note: read as sentences against the clear minute of the same letter; 3 probable words and 3 restored letters, all confirmed by the minute; content existing (the minute)

outcome.notes: The letter has its clear minute in the same file, so we claim no new text and no solution; what is new is the key as a reusable table (7 x 4 grid of stacked digit pairs), validated on a held-out passage, and the identification of the pair. No images: the Nationaal Archief record states no licence.
